versions.changelog: Restructure: nest skill folder for git/clawhub separation

Initial release of chart-renderer-open.

- Generate self-contained HTML reports with heatmaps, line charts, tables, and category cards from structured data.
- Modular: loads only the CSS/JS/docs needed for the user's requested chart types.
- Supports multiple chart types including heatmap, line, dual axis, recommendation cards, and tiered category cards.
- One-click screenshot and download-ready reports, suitable for dashboards and analyses.
- Full data and rendering specs provided via on-demand template files.
- Simple export path with preview embed for generated reports.
